notes.title: The RUNNER UPDATE
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURES!

- New Weapons added , a sub-machine-gun , assault rifle , semi-automatic shotgun and a machete.

- New UI features.

- New Songs and in-Game Sounds.

- New options: mouse sensitivity and screen options.

- Checkpoints in some levels.

- New animations.

We hope you like it! let us know what you think of this update.
